cells.gaps: The October 2025 workshop on the universal access texts published its twelve comments and answers, but its participants are not shown to come from outside government; no rule-required consultation or standing body.
cells.note: ARN-TIC put the draft Electronic Transactions Law out for written comment in May 2026, a consultation held. The only published answers, to the October 2025 universal access workshop, come from a workshop whose participants are not named, so not stage 3.
